studies.title: Lake Texcoco · around 1500
studies.caption: Lake Texcoco around 1500, before the drainage works that transformed the Valley of Mexico.
studies.prompt: Historical landscape of Lake Texcoco around1500, view from a low eastern shoreline over broad shallow lake with reeds and water birds; Tenochtitlan a small distant island settlement linked by thin causeways at far LEFT, mountains hazy beyond. Water dominates, no gigantic floating pyramids, modern Mexico City or European churches.
